name: Restless
description: Rest drains 50% faster until he sleeps 4 hours.

name: Weak
description: Maximum Health −10; deals 25% less damage in a fight.

name: Shaken
description: Searches take 25% longer. An hour's rest at home or by a fire ends it.

name: Infected wound
description: Health −1 an hour and no healing until treated with a sterilized bandage or neem–turmeric paste.
